policy: Exclude assets/beauties entirely. Keep artwork consumed by runtime, including dynamic paths; remove superseded artwork, composition assets and source images even when legacy tools reference them.

nestedCleanup.policy: Runtime use determines retention. Legacy composition and superseded envoy portraits removed; official portraits still used by UI retained.
nestedCleanup.verification: tests/asset-usage.test.mjs recursively checks all remaining non-beauty artwork against runtime asset paths and confirms every country legacy portrait resolves to a complete PNG.

finalRecheck.method: Trace module and stylesheet imports from index.html; verify dynamic families and registered portrait variants against actual UI fields.
